description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR) ETH/STANDARD pool buys and sells grouped by wallets that held at least one Charter at the exact block and log position of each swap. Current ownership is not applied retroactively, each swap is counted once even when its wallet held multiple Charters, and ambiguous multi-swap transactions are excluded rather than assigned to a guessed wallet. Filter with hours and limit. Fields ending in _raw are integer base-unit amounts returned as strings.

hours.description: Hours of flow history to return (default 24, maximum 720)
